instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Catalyst is an adventure tourism operator specializing in guided hiking, canyoning, and rock climbing experiences across 3 national parks. They manage a high volume of activities with 25 certified guides leading approximately 4,000 clients annually. The company operates from several dispersed locations requiring robust coordination for booking, safety waivers, and guide scheduling.
answers.pastInitiatives: We piloted a cloud-based project management tool last year, but adoption was inconsistent across teams and we ultimately reverted to spreadsheets and email for most project tracking. The experience highlighted that tool adoption requires more structured change management than we initially planned for.
answers.strategicGoals: Customer retention has declined from 92% to 84% over the past 18 months, primarily among our mid-tier and enterprise segments. Exit interviews consistently cite product stagnation and poor digital self-service tools as reasons for leaving. We need to urgently modernize our customer-facing technology and proactively address the specific pain points driving churn before the trend becomes irreversible.
answers.additionalContext: As local regulations remain straightforward, the primary competitive pressure comes from optimizing operational efficiency and ensuring a superior guest experience via technology. We face seasonal demand spikes which currently stress our informal processes.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 4-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

opportunities.title: Streamlined Self-Service Booking Portal (Quick Win)
opportunities.rationale: Implementing a basic, mobile-first booking portal directly addresses customer churn complaints regarding poor digital self-service tools. This is an incremental step that improves conversion and reduces administrative load for the small tech team.

first_actions: Define Minimum Viable Product (MVP) features: basic itinerary viewing, payment gateway integration.
Identify a low-cost SaaS solution or outsourced development contract.
resources_needed: Allocation of 10% developer capacity over 3 months
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in direct booking conversion rate by 5%
milestones: Q1: Finalize tech stack selection and wireframes.
Q2: Launch beta version to 5 key clients.

opportunities.title: Automated Safety Waiver Management System
opportunities.rationale: Transitioning manual safety waiver handling to a digital system will reduce administrative errors and improve compliance, which is critical for market defense in the tourism sector. This builds upon existing operational processes.

first_actions: Map out current waiver workflow and identify automation points (e.g., conditional email triggers).
resources_needed: Budget allocation for mid-tier CRM/workflow tool ($5k)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in waiver processing errors by 80%
milestones: Q3: System implementation and staff training.
Q4: Full rollout across all guiding departments.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Hyper-Personalized Itinerary Generator
opportunities.rationale: Develop an AI engine that uses real-time booking data and user preferences to generate dynamic, personalized adventure itineraries. This is a radical move that would redefine the customer experience and create significant differentiation in a low-pressure market.

first_actions: Conduct feasibility study on LLM integration with existing operational data.
Pilot development of an MVP using current internal project management tools.
resources_needed: Hiring or contracting a specialized AI/ML consultant
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 20% increase in average customer spend per booking
milestones: Q3: Proof of concept for itinerary generation.
Q1 Year 2: Full integration into the core platform.

next_steps.action: Conduct a focused workshop with leadership to prioritize the Quick Win (Booking Portal) and secure dedicated time for its execution.
Audit current operational processes against industry best practices for waiver management, defining requirements for the automated system.
Develop a low-cost proof-of-concept (POC) plan for AI itinerary generation to test feasibility and resource needs.

key_weaknesses: Lack of formal innovation pipeline, leading to inconsistent project execution and 'start-stop' cycles.
Low digital maturity (Level 1), making the company highly vulnerable to customer churn driven by poor self-service options.
Innovation is currently constrained by a tight budget (9%) and informal decision-making structure that lacks strategic alignment across all departments.
Inconsistent change management processes, resulting in failed adoption of previous digital tool experiments.
